definitions.financing_per_adj_inhabitant_eur: Hacienda Cuadro 2.2.3 col (5): financiación homogénea (resources provided by the system minus non-homogeneous competences) / adjusted population, before the Fondo de Competitividad and Fondo de Cooperación (it is the figure used to allocate the Fondo de Competitividad). Euros, liquidation year 2024.
definitions.financing_index_avg100: financing_per_adj_inhabitant_eur / common-regime Total row of Cuadro 2.2.3 col (5) (3.475,53 €) x 100. Derived ratio, not printed in the source.
definitions.financing_after_convergence_funds_per_ad: Derived: (Cuadro 2.2.3 col 3 financiación homogénea + Cuadro 3 col 7 Fondo de Competitividad + col 8 Fondo de Cooperación) / Cuadro 1.9.1 col 23 población ajustada. Closest to the usual «financiación definitiva a competencias homogéneas por habitante ajustado» but computed here, not printed by Hacienda; convergence funds are added in full without any homogeneity adjustment.
definitions.spending_per_inhabitant_eur: Obligaciones reconocidas netas, operaciones no financieras (chapters 1-7), consolidated regional public sector under budgetary accounting, depurado IFL y PAC, 2024 / INE ECP resident population at 1 July 2024.
definitions.gdp_per_inhabitant_eur: INE CRE PIB a precios de mercado per cápita, precios corrientes, 2024 (INE data-type code 2: not yet final).
definitions.adjusted_population: Hacienda Cuadro 1.9.1 col (23), población ajustada 2024 (needs-weighted population used by the system).

gaps: País Vasco and Navarra: no financing per adjusted inhabitant. They are outside the common system (Concierto/Convenio); no official comparable figure was downloaded (Fundación BBVA-Ivie / AIReF / Fedea estimates not fetched). Fields are null.

País Vasco spending covers the Basque Government consolidated sector only; most tax collection and part of spending sit with the Diputaciones Forales, and both foral communities hold competences (e.g. police, prisons in PV, roads in NC) not held by every common-regime CA. Not comparable one-to-one.

Spending of common-regime CCAA also includes non-homogeneous competences (e.g. Mossos/police in Cataluña, prisons in Cataluña) and Canarias has a separate tax regime (REF, no VAT in the system); compare with caution.
financing_index_avg100 is computed from the source (ratio to the Total row), not printed by Hacienda; no official per-capita index with average 100 exists in the downloaded cuadros.
Ceuta and Melilla not included (optional; in Cuadro 3 of the liquidation they only carry Fondo de Suficiencia Global and Fondo de Cooperación amounts).
GDP 2024 is not final in INE CRE (data-type code 2); 2025 avance also in the file but not used for year consistency.
Liquidation 2025 not yet available (published July of t+2); 2024 is the latest year for financing and liquidated budgets as of 2026-10-19.
